summary.intent: Execute Phase 19.2 gap closure plans for IPFS upload performance optimization, then run a four-pass load test (concurrency probe + three-point before/after comparison) to produce definitive, matched-environment baselines for the SDK concurrent-pin and Kubo pebbleds optimizations.
summary.outcome: Both original Phase 19.2 plans executed and verified with two gaps found (PERF-09 missing from REQUIREMENTS.md, non-definitive baselines). Gap closure plans created and plan 19.2-04 revised to use a local four-run methodology. PERF-09 registered (plan 19.2-03 complete). Concurrency probe completed (50 clients = clean ceiling). Run 1 baseline (sequential SDK + flatfs, 50 clients) captured. Run 2 (concurrent SDK + flatfs) was in progress at end of session.

repo: Load test secrets (LOAD_TEST_SECRET, THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET) must be passed as inline shell env vars — vitest does not load dotenv, so values in tests/load/.env are ignored at runtime.
Rate limiting is bypassed via X-Throttle-Bypass header (BypassableThrottlerGuard) only when NODE_ENV !== 'production'; LOAD_TEST_SECRET authenticates test account creation via POST /auth/test-login.
DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL in apps/api/.env controls IPNS routing; was pointing to mock-ipns-routing (localhost:3001), must be set to someguy at 192.168.133.114:8190 for representative testing.
Kubo/IPFS throughput hard-caps around 3.4–3.5 ops/s regardless of client count (10–50 clients); adding concurrency does not increase throughput but does balloon latency linearly.
JWT tokens expire under sustained long-running load tests at 75+ clients, causing 401 errors and cascading 500s ('Key wrapping failed', 'Folder not loaded').
50 concurrent clients is the highest clean ceiling (zero errors, completes within timeout); 75 clients starts hitting auth token expiry and timeouts.

code.finding: uploadFile was updated to use Promise.allSettled to parallelize IPNS publish and folder metadata update (previously sequential); this is the SDK-layer optimization being validated in the baseline runs.
Captures per-operation p50/p95/p99/min/max/avg latencies and throughput ops/s — sufficient for three-point optimization comparison.
Scenario runs N clients × 20 files each (1KB–500KB); client count controlled by LOAD_TEST_CLIENTS env var.
DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL changed from http://localhost:3001 (mock-ipns-routing) to http://192.168.133.114:8190 (someguy) for this baseline session.

workflow: Comparing pre/post baselines captured in different environments (staging vs localhost, different client counts) produces non-definitive results — same-environment three-point methodology avoids this confound.
When a git checkout is run from within a subdirectory (tests/load), the relative path to a file in another package resolves incorrectly; must run from repo root or use absolute paths.
GSD plan files should be updated with concrete execution details (exact commands, env vars, client counts) before execution begins so context is not lost if the session ends mid-run.
Background tasks via run_in_background accumulate task-notification messages that arrive out-of-order; spot-checking via TaskOutput is necessary to reconcile results before acting on them.

friction: Original phase 19.2 baselines were captured in mismatched environments (staging for pre-optimization, localhost for post-optimization), making the verification non-definitive and requiring a full gap-closure cycle.
PERF-09 was referenced in plans but never added to REQUIREMENTS.md, causing a requirements traceability gap caught only at verification.
Load test secrets silently fail when placed in tests/load/.env because vitest does not invoke dotenv — no error is thrown, tests just run unauthenticated.
API server was not running when load tests were initiated and had to be started mid-session before any tests could run.
git checkout of a pre-optimization file failed silently when the working directory was tests/load — the relative path did not resolve correctly, requiring a workaround from the repo root.
open_items: Run 2 (concurrent SDK + flatfs, 50 clients) was in progress at end of session — results not yet captured.
Run 3 (concurrent SDK + pebbleds, 50 clients) not yet started — requires Docker volume wipe and pebbleds stack redeployment on 192.168.133.114.
